resources.string: For continued location sync in the background, review these two system settings for AlphaPro.
Allow location first. If Android no longer shows a prompt, open App permissions. Location accuracy follows your permission choice.
In system App info, choose Permissions → Location → “%1$s”. On some phones the path or wording differs.
This Android version has no separate background-location permission. Allowing location is sufficient for this permission check.
Background location access is allowed. You can review or change it in App permissions.
Open the optimization list, choose All apps if needed, find AlphaPro, then select Don’t optimize. This reduces screen-off interruptions without disabling global Battery Saver.

These choices are optional and can be revisited here. Some manufacturers also require Unrestricted / Allow background activity in app battery settings. They do not guarantee uninterrupted syncing on every phone.
Could not open this system page. Please check AlphaPro in system App info.
Location permission is needed for GPS sync. After allowing it, turn GPS sync on again or reconnect the camera.
